title: Check Box
text: Select parameter or variable value, {Label} sets Block label position; {Connection} sets the block parameter value to connect parameter value connection, {Check Box Label} sets the description of check box, {Checked/Unchecked Values} sets the values to assign for checked and unchecked states Unchecked, {Opacity} sets the block background opacity, {Foreground Color} sets the block foreground color and {Background Color} sets the block background color. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Connection
params.values: Block parameter value to connect parameter value connection options

params.name: Check Box Label
params.values: Description of check box action Label (default) | character vector

params.name: Checked/Unchecked Values
params.values: Values to assign for checked and unchecked states Unchecked: 0 Checked: 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Label
params.values: Block label position Hide (default) | Bottom | Top

params.name: Foreground Color
params.values: Block foreground color [r g b] vector

params.name: Background Color
params.values: Block background color [r g b] vector
